c_doubts.decision: Retain $\Theta$.
c_doubts.evidence: Closed oval and horizontal median bar are described consistently in all three reader reports; root retains the symbol.

c_doubts.decision: Retain the upper and lower rules on both I/II pairs. Draw the Raynaud I enclosure as the open-ended elongated curve selected by root; it is not an insertion leader.
c_doubts.evidence: R2-D03 and R3-D03 describe separate upper ends of the top enclosure and separate head/foot rules on I and II. Root inspected the R3 top crop and chose the open enclosure. The first Illusie pair retains its independently reported numeral rules.

c_doubts.decision: Retain both long unheaded diagonals in their positioned locations beside the Hartshorne and Quillen letter entries.
c_doubts.evidence: The reader reports describe two separate rising-right strokes. Root additionally inspected crops 21_first_slash_hartshorne.png and 22_second_slash.png. The first rises from below-left of lettres; the second rises from beside the following Notes row toward Lettres.
c_doubts.bbox_source: whole image, 1681 x 2138 pixels; two separate diagonal loci

c_doubts.decision: Retain cot$_{\unsure{*|+}}$ with the small mark below the baseline.
c_doubts.evidence: All three reports describe a compact low intersection with lateral and vertical components and an obscured oblique edge. Root retains the star/plus alternatives and does not expand cot in the reading.

c_doubts.decision: Retain $\Omega^{1}$ with the numeral raised at the upper right.
c_doubts.evidence: All three reports describe an open-bottom capital with two feet and a separately raised upright or hooked 1. Root retains this symbol and exponent.

c_doubts.decision: Retain paired opening and paired closing quotation strokes around On monodromy. Preserve the rising entry and the higher closing pair.
c_doubts.evidence: R1-D35 and R2-D36 identify doubled quote strokes, while R3-D36/D37 split the two pairs and R3-D39 records their rising placement. Root adopts quotation pairs and their relative heights.

c_doubts.decision: Retain (\uuline{13}) with two short lower rules, separately from the two long Artin-entry cancellations.
c_doubts.evidence: All three reports distinguish the ordinary Arabic 1 and 3 and two low rules from the two independent long cancellation paths. Root preserves both pairs of lines with their separate functions.

c_doubts.decision: Retain $p\unsure{\ne|>}0$. Preserve the three separately drawn terminal tracks without assigning each to the relation or cancellation; place the final period live outside the deleted text.
c_doubts.evidence: The reports agree on p, an obscured intersecting/angular relation, and a closed zero. R3-D34 describes three terminal tracks; R3-D35 describes the separate point beyond/below the strike. Root inspected the R3 Serre-right crop and selected those tracks and the live period while retaining the relation alternatives.

c_doubts.decision: Use f\unsure{o|u}nction, with the o candidate first and doubt confined to that vowel.
c_doubts.evidence: R1 and R2 describe a closed or nearly closed first vowel loop that favours o but still admits u; the longer foundations sequence is not supported in their reports. Root chose the local o/u doubt.

c_doubts.decision: Retain the whole-name doubt \unsure{Artin}-Winters.
c_doubts.evidence: R1 and R2 report overlapping dark inner uprights that prevent complete separation of the Artin cluster. Root retains the whole-name uncertainty rather than R3’s narrower ti span.

c_doubts.decision: Retain the whole-name doubt \unsure{Monsky-Washnitzer} at the first occurrence; the second occurrence remains unmarked.
c_doubts.evidence: R1 and R2 describe compressed or pale joined strokes in the first second-name run. Root retains that whole-name uncertainty; all three readers give the second occurrence without a doubt marker.

c_doubts.decision: Resolve as lowercase plural lettres Hartshorne.
c_doubts.evidence: R2 and R3 describe a terminal s-shaped or long hooked stroke following the r/e movement. Root adopts the plural and lowercase initial.

c_doubts.decision: Resolve as capitalized plural Lettres Quillen.
c_doubts.evidence: R2 and R3 describe an e turn followed by a longer terminal s-like hook. Root adopts the plural; the initial capital L and Quillen are retained.

c_doubts.decision: Retain \unsure{infinitésimales}.
c_doubts.evidence: R1 and R3 report pale medial joins and covered accent/letter regions that do not support an unqualified word. Root retains the whole-word doubt.

c_doubts.decision: Use t\unsure{a|o}pis, keeping only the first-vowel alternatives and dropping topos.
c_doubts.evidence: All three reports identify the p descender and a separate point over the following short stroke, supporting i in the last vowel position. Root confines the remaining doubt to a/o.

c_doubts.decision: Use (\unsure{pluriel}) Quillen, with the closing parenthesis before the separately written Quillen.
c_doubts.evidence: R3 describes an early descender and tall loop that favour tentative pluriel, with faint internal joins unresolved. R1/R2/R3 agree that Quillen follows the closing parenthesis. Root retains tentative pluriel and drops Gabriel.

c_doubts.decision: Resolve as pour.
c_doubts.evidence: All three reports distinguish a small o followed by a separate u movement between p and r. Root accepts pour without a doubt marker.

c_doubts.decision: Replace the textual alternatives with three graphic units: short dash, compact point, bowed terminal dash with a darker attached endpoint.
c_doubts.evidence: R2 and R3 describe the first unit as a short dash and the next as a point. R1 and R2 separately record a darker endpoint attached to the final bowed or wavering dash. Root selects that combined explicit geometry, still three disconnected units.

c_doubts.decision: Resolve as Borel. Preserve the separate short uncertain lower oblique trace as a graphic; root shortens it to the path from source (549,1042) to (561,1033).
c_doubts.evidence: All three reports resolve the Borel letter sequence. R2 separately records a lower oblique trace whose affiliation to lettering or cancellation is uncertain; root retains a shortened local version of that trace without extending the uncertainty to the name.

c_doubts.place: Deligne adjacent mark, including recovered question-mark metadata
c_doubts.decision: Retain \unsure{1|2|?} beside Deligne and preserve the two overlapping tracks selected from R3. Do not assign an order of writing to the tracks.
c_doubts.evidence: R3-D24 describes a shorter hooked/looped track and taller right track; all three candidate readings remain possible. Root adopts the two tracks. The recovered C prose note concerns this same locus and adds no separate mark.

c_doubts.decision: Use the deleted parenthesis (\unsure{questions|suite|suiten}). Preserve the R1 looped mesh and sweep as a locally uncertain graphic.
c_doubts.evidence: R1-D25 tentatively admits questions from a descending initial loop and longer run while retaining suite/suiten; R2/R3 retain only the latter two. Root chooses all three candidates and the R1 looping geometry, adding local graphic uncertainty for the path decomposition. The deletion state is retained independently of the uncertain wording and tracing.

c_doubts.decision: Use \unsure{Ch.|Coh.}, with Ch. first and Coh. retained.
c_doubts.evidence: R1 and R3 describe a large C, h-like stem and detached low stop; a possible small o meets the cancellation. Root retains both abbreviated readings and does not expand them in the text.

c_doubts.decision: Resolve as four literal continuation points: ....
c_doubts.evidence: All three reports count four separate units after monodromy, with some elongated and some compact. Root adopts the four-point reading without normalizing it to a three-dot ellipsis.

c_doubts.decision: Retain \unsure{Rietzly|Rietzley}.
c_doubts.evidence: All three reports describe the cancellation and descenders from the preceding line crossing medial letters and a possible extra e. Root keeps both tentative name candidates; the H unread span is local to this name.

c_doubts.decision: Retain \unsure{class}; field and thy remain outside that word-level doubt.
c_doubts.evidence: All three reports identify the opening cl while the low remaining letters meet the cancellation. Root retains the local whole-word doubt on class, with the separate field sequence readable.

c_doubts.decision: Resolve the final abbreviation as thy.
c_doubts.evidence: R2 and R3 describe a long descent connected to the final letter body and distinct from the continuing cancellation. Root accepts y rather than a stop; the class doubt remains separate.

c_doubts.decision: Use \unsure{Que|Qui}, keeping e first and retaining i as an alternative.
c_doubts.evidence: R2 describes a low final loop favouring e without a securely separate i dot. Root adopts the reversed candidate preference while retaining both readings and the separately cancelled start.

c_doubts.decision: Retain deleted \unsure{intermédiaires}; place its terminal period live outside the deletion.
c_doubts.evidence: The reports retain uncertainty where the long strike covers medial or final joins. R3-D50 describes the final point beyond/below the strike endpoint. Root inspected the R2 Weil region and selected the tentative word with the live final point.

c_doubts.decision: Use arithm\unsure{è|é|e}tiques, with grave first and the remaining letters unmarked.
c_doubts.evidence: R3 reports that the letter sequence is separable but the small upper stroke could be grave, distorted acute, or part of the adjacent tall letter. Root localizes the doubt to the vowel/accent and preserves the three alternatives.

c_doubts.decision: Use Hard\unsure{er,|y}, one coupled doubt: Harder with comma or Hardy without a separate comma.
c_doubts.evidence: R3 describes a small cup, rise and downward tail that admit er plus a comma or a joined y. Root keeps the alternatives coupled rather than adding an independent comma doubt.

notes: Exactly 30 distinct C-question loci are represented. The packet’s 32 table rows repeat the low cot mark and Serre relation. The recovered question-mark note is incorporated into the existing Deligne mark locus.

The inventory reconciles R3’s 60 positional elements with R1 variants and root’s stated final choices, then adds the root-retained shortened Borel oblique trace, for 61 elements. It does not retain R3’s four-hatch pattern after root selected the locally uncertain R1 looped mesh.

All C witness strings are literal substrings of the assigned C.tex. Observational evidence is attributed to the saved reader reports and root’s stated crop decisions; the text-audit agent viewed no images, used no OCR, and made no independent ink claim.

The two final points after Serre and Weil are live, separate from their deleted title text. The short Qui/Que line is covered by the local deleted-state scope as directed by root; the long Lettre line remains an independent geometry element.

Word uncertainty and graphic uncertainty remain local: clear Borel coexists with an uncertain lower trace; the Deligne parenthetic wording and its looped graphic are both doubtful; terminal Serre tracks retain unassigned affiliation without changing the separate relation alternatives; the final Harder-comma/Hardy alternatives form a single coupled doubt.

The selected tail after Omega1 has three disconnected units even though the final unit includes an attached darker endpoint. The Artin entry has two short numeral underlines and two separate long cancellation paths.

Source crop paths and bounding boxes are reused as metadata references from reader reports known by root to have been inspected. For the combined two-diagonal C-question locus, crop is null because root inspected two separate new crops (21 and 22). Root must review these references before committing final metadata.
